end.summary:
Practised plant-eaters, meat-eaters, and animals that eat both.
Built and read food chains using arrows in 4 examples.
Explained energy movement from food to eater in examples with leaves, caterpillars, algae, larvae, and fish.
Predicted effects of removing a food source or animal from a chain.
Animal diet labels need further practice; teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Asha practised food chains with arrows and asked Manav to explain why energy moves from one living thing to another. Manav correctly built four chains and predicted changes when part of a chain was removed, including fewer snakes when grasshoppers increase. Naming animals as plant-eaters, meat-eaters, or both needs more practice. At home, ask Manav to sort five familiar animals into these three groups and explain what each eats.
